title: Lena and the Thorn
author: Marguerite Dravenmoor
blurb: Gideon Winterbourne, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
